deferred.string: 'TL;DR', 'Note', 'Tip', 'Warning', 'Danger', 'Key takeaway', 'Risk', 'Difficulty', 'Cost', 'Results in', 'Reversibility', 'Needs a professional', 'Yes', 'Item', 'Dose', 'Frequency', 'Duration', 'Before', 'After', ' — source attached', and the Tiers::LABEL/SHORT values interpolated at lines 137 and 197
deferred.reason: USER-VISIBLE and the largest untranslated surface in this extension, but it CANNOT be a string swap. These literals are compiled into the s9e/TextFormatter XSLT by Extend\Formatter::configure, which Flarum builds ONCE and caches (storage/formatter/*); the renderer is not rebuilt per request, so a trans() here would freeze whichever locale happened to be active when the cache was warmed and serve it to everybody. The audit's xml-fragment/not-prose rule excluded all of them, correctly by its own rule and wrongly for the reader. What it would take, in the order it should be done: (1) in Configure.php emit a marker instead of the text — 'Warning' — keeping the English as the element's text so an un-swapped render is still readable; (2) add one sweep to js/dist/forum.js decorate(), after the header is inserted, that does body.querySelectorAll('[data-lmx-t]').forEach(el => el.textContent = flarum.core.app.translator.trans('local-looksmax-guides.' + el.dataset.lmxT)); (3) do the same for the img alt= on GuideBA-before/after, which needs setAttribute rather than textContent. Every key it needs is already written and translated in locale/en.yml and locale/es.yml under forum.block, forum.callout, forum.spec, forum.stack, forum.ba, forum.claim and forum.tier. Around 25 lines across the two files.

Proposal: drop the three rules and have Configure::stack() emit the label inside each cell as a real element (it already emits the cells), which then rides along on the data-lmx-t sweep above. NOT an i18n issue — reported because it is in a file I was reading and would otherwise be lost. forumApp() returns the MODULE, whose app is on .default (compare looksmax-userinfo/js/dist/forum.js:1050-1057, which does `appModule.default || appModule`). So sweep()'s guard `if (!app || !app.current || !app.current.get) return false;` at line 477 is always false-y and the cold-load sweeper at line 528 runs all 15 attempts and never decorates. Fix is one line: `var mod = registry()['app'] || registry()['forum/app']; return (mod && mod.default) || mod;`. This is in another lane's file, so it is not in `replacements`.
